results.name: unpublished school: public read returns live data, no document (renderer generates)
admin saves and publishes; drafts never leak to the public
tenant isolation: other school's admin, teachers and anon cannot read or write a site
validator rejects script URLs, unknown blocks, bad variants, missing home, duplicates, oversize
optimistic concurrency: a stale editor cannot overwrite a newer draft
rollback republishes an old version as a new version; history is immutable
custom domains: only verified hostnames resolve; host never falls back to a slug
opt-in personal data: staff only with a visible staff block; hostels and alumni only as totals
publish needs a draft and the catalog; website.manage permission is registered
